Class TribeCard

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsoft.mesos.server.model.game.cards.Card
it.polimi.ingsoft.mesos.server.model.game.cards.TribeCard
All Implemented Interfaces:
CardAction
Direct Known Subclasses:
CharacterCard, EventCard
public abstract class TribeCard extends Card
Base class for every card contained in the tribe deck.

In addition to the generic card fields, tribe cards expose their logical type so that the model can distinguish between characters and events and apply type-specific rules.
